format: skywalker-x8 game delivery metadata v1 (structure modelled on the OpenRC aircraft delivery specification; not an openrc-aircraft v2 physics file)

aircraft.note_display_name: to be chosen by the simulator team / owner

configuration.description: UAV: mapping camera behind two articulated ventral doors, parachute pack inside the bay, magnetic top hatch that can separate (section canopy); controls, doors and propeller neutral; battery centre 228 mm from the nose; skins abisal (default) and bolido

tools.runtime: Python bpy module 5.2.2 (pip) on Linux x86_64
tools.note: the blender -b commands in README.md are the equivalent invocation; the delivery was produced and verified with the bpy module build above

frames.blender_game_scene: +X right wing (pilot's right), +Y nose (forward), +Z up; metres; origin = D0
frames.master_v3_blender: X = -s (left wing at +X), Y aft, Z up, origin at x = 440 mm from the nose (nominal CG); mm tables: x aft from nose, s right, z up

conversion.godot_from_blender: godot = (blender.x, blender.z, -blender.y), applied once by the Y-up glTF export
conversion.blender_from_master_mm: blender = (s, x_D0 - x, z - z_D0) / 1000 with x aft from the nose, s to the right, z up (master tables, mm)

datum_D0.definition: symmetry plane; x = leading edge of the wing at the orange root rib (s = 236 mm, wing/centre-body joint); z = thrust-axis height (motor shaft)
datum_D0.note: D0 is not the CG. Root node has zero translation/rotation and unit scale.
datum_D0.incidence_dihedral_washout: preserved from the master (root incidence 0, dihedral 1.5 deg, washout -2.5 deg at the tip)

D0.note: symmetry plane; leading edge of the wing at the orange root rib station (s = 236 mm); thrust-axis (motor shaft) height

wing_root_leading_edge_left.source: wing_left_fixed root section vertices (s = 237.6 mm), max +Y
wing_root_leading_edge_left.note: root skin section just outboard of the orange rib

wing_root_leading_edge_right.source: wing_right_fixed root section vertices (s = 237.6 mm), max +Y
wing_root_leading_edge_right.note: root skin section just outboard of the orange rib

cg_reference_manufacturer_430mm.source: Skywalker spec sheet: CG 430-440 mm from the nose

control_mixing.surfaces: two elevons (no separate ailerons, elevator, rudder or flaps)
control_mixing.convention: angles in degrees of surface rotation, + = trailing edge down
control_mixing.formula: elevon_left = roll - pitch ; elevon_right = -roll - pitch (pitch + = nose up, roll + = right wing down)
control_mixing.default_rates: pitch 0.70, roll 0.85 of the servo travel inside the mix (master radio configuration); ArduPilot SERVO1/2_FUNCTION 77/78

skins.label: ABISAL - deep-sea anglerfish
skins.description: Original deep-sea anglerfish scheme: blue-black iridescent scales, photophores, fin rays, mouth with fangs and lure, false eyes on the winglets, worn like a working UAV.
skins.concept: Deep-sea anglerfish skin on a flying wing: blue-black body with iridescent scales on the back, silver-violet belly with rows of photophores, segmented fin rays on the wings with a violet trailing edge, a bioluminescent lateral line, an open mouth with fangs and a glowing lure on the nose, false eyes on the winglets, coral gill slits at the wing root; worn like a working UAV (chipped edges showing EPO foam, belly scrapes and grass stains, insects on leading edges, dirt in seams, hand prints, a tape repair, faded technical stencils).

skins.label: BOLIDO - re-entry heat shield
skins.description: Original re-entry-demonstrator scheme: black ceramic tiles below, quilted blankets above, carbon-carbon leading edges, heat stains and flight-test markings.
skins.concept: Re-entry demonstrator inspired by the Space Shuttle thermal protection system: black reaction-cured-glass ceramic tiles on the underside (22 mm, laid along the body axis, the leading-edge sweep and the hinge line), each tile with its own age tone, part number and waterproofing holes, replaced tiles in fresh gloss black; white 44 mm tiles at the black/white transition; cream quilted insulation blankets on top; grey carbon-carbon nose cap and leading-edge panels with T-seals; white felt on the elevons; a temper-coloured metal heat shield around the motor. Use: plasma bleaching and flow streaks on the belly (strongest at the nose and leading edges), tobacco-brown heat stains on the blankets, chipped tiles showing white silica, one missing tile with the felt pad, primer and adhesive exposed, protruding gap fillers, grease-pencil inspection rings, photogrammetry targets, rescue arrows, Spanish stencils and unlit navigation-light lenses (red left, green right, white tail; no lamp system is installed).

texture_memory.estimate_basis: uncompressed: 4 images x 2048^2 x 4 bytes x 4/3 (mipmaps). Compressed: three 4-bit-per-pixel blocks (BC1/ETC2 class: base colour, ORM, emission) and one 8-bit-per-pixel normal map (BC5/RGTC class), with mipmaps. Estimate only: the real import format and cost must be measured in Godot (pending integration).

default_skin_paint_targets.region_attribute: face attribute x8_region on each painted mesh: 0 skin, 1 hinge tape, 2 servo cover, 3 orange plastic (root ribs, control horns), 4 propeller
default_skin_paint_targets.part_attribute: face attribute x8_part: 1 fuselage_core, 2 canopy_hatch, 3 wing_left_fixed, 4 wing_right_fixed, 5 elevon_left, 6 elevon_right, 7 camera_door_left, 8 camera_door_right, 9 propeller_rotor
default_skin_paint_targets.note: Workshop paint slots and registration markings apply to the default skin only; alternate skins are not promised arbitrary repainting.

lights.note: The X8 UAV configuration of the master has no lamp system; no simulator light groups (navigation, strobe, landing, orientation) are declared. BOLIDO paints unlit lens shapes (anchors under skins[].unlit_light_lenses); ABISAL has decorative always-on bioluminescent emission, which is paint, not a lamp.

mechanisms.propeller: propeller_spin (rotor separate from the fixed motor_mount)
mechanisms.canopy: canopy_hatch is a detachable section only (no opening mechanism)

demo_glb.animation: demo (24 fps, 560 frames): elevons, doors, propeller, exploded sections; reference only

known_limits: Servo arms and pushrods are not exported: the simulator drives only the hinge, so a static linkage would misalign when the elevons move (silhouette difference below the wing at s = +-515 mm).
Servos ES3054 inside the wing bays, magnets, tabs, latch pin, spring, carbon tubes and fasteners are hidden in flight and are not exported.

Hinge tape, servo covers and orange plastic are painted regions of the x8_livery atlas (face attribute x8_region) plus a 2 mm slot cover on each elevon; no separate shells and no coplanar decal geometry.
The magnetic hatch is tagged canopy so it can separate; the X8 has no glazing.
Wing/centre-body joint: 0.1 mm hidden separation on each side of the orange rib.
No landing gear, tail surfaces, flaps or rudder exist on this aircraft.
Mass and CG values are manual values or non-flight estimates only.
Elevon positive-deflection clearance ends at about 31 deg (game tessellation of the 35 deg lower chamfer); the authored range is +-26.8 deg.

Liveries: everything listed as render_only (ABISAL iridescence and coat; BOLIDO incandescence, plasma sheath, temper-colour thin film) exists only in the Cycles renders; the GLBs use core glTF (no KHR_materials_* extensions).
Liveries: emission is exported at factor 1.0; glow is an engine-side setting.
ABISAL: the FPV window (x8_glass) interrupts the row of teeth on the nose.
Liveries: interior foam, metal, glass, motor bell, motor mount and bay equipment keep flat materials in every skin.
Liveries: wear, dirt and markings are baked into each atlas (one look per skin); there is no clean variant or runtime decal layer.

BOLIDO: the tile grid uses planar projections per zone (belly, sides, nose front, each wing along its leading edge, each elevon along its hinge, winglets); where two zones meet, tiles end at a closeout line, as on real heat shields, and on the strongly curved nose sides tiles are slightly stretched.
BOLIDO is a visual concept: the paint does not imply real thermal protection; mass and aerodynamics are those of the foam X8.
